Package com.github.gumtreediff.matchers

Class MappingStore

java.lang.Object
com.github.gumtreediff.matchers.MappingStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<Mapping>
public class MappingStore extends Object implements Iterable<Mapping>
Class dedicated to store mappings between two ASTs. Internally, the mappings are stored via two hashmaps.

  • Constructor Details

    • MappingStore

      public MappingStore(MappingStore ms)
      Instantiate a mapping store using the mappings of the provided mapping store. The references to the source and destination AST are also copied from the provided mapping store.

    • MappingStore

      public MappingStore(Tree src, Tree dst)
      Instantiate a new empty mapping store between the provided source and destination AST.

    • addMapping

      public void addMapping(Tree src, Tree dst)
      Add a mapping between the two provided nodes inside the mapping store.

    • addMappingRecursively

      public void addMappingRecursively(Tree src, Tree dst)
      Add a mapping between the two provided nodes inside the mapping store. Mappings between all descendants of the two nodes are added as well. The trees rooted at the source and destination nodes are expected to be at least iso structural.
      See Also:
      • Tree.isIsoStructuralTo(Tree)
